# TS-001: Tailscale is logged in and Running when installed

- **Group:** Tailscale
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

A node that dropped to NeedsLogin or Stopped (or whose tailscaled is not running) has no tailscale0 traffic: every firewall rule scoped to tailscale0 or 100.64.0.0/10 silently matches nothing, while everyone still believes SSH and the panel are private. Closing public SSH on such a host locks you out.

## Verify by hand

```sh
tailscale status; systemctl status tailscaled
```

## How to fix it

tailscale up (log the node in again), then prove SSH over the tailnet from a new session before relying on any tailnet only rule

## What a fix can break

Nothing; logging in restores the tailnet paths the firewall already expects.
